_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: income_sources
constraints: CHECK (day_of_month IS NULL OR day_of_month BETWEEN 1 AND 31)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "monthly_limit_minor" INTEGER NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "income_sources" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_of_month" INTEGER NULL, "date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (day_of_month IS NULL OR day_of_month BETWEEN 1 AND 31));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_limit_minor" INTEGER NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_category_limits" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "budget_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "op_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_fields" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "reject_reason" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_sync_at" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'changed', "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "old_value" TEXT NULL, "new_value" TEXT NULL, "changed_by" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "server_rows" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity", "entity_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "groups" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "members" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_backfills" ("group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shared_expenses" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "split" TEXT NOT NULL, "shares" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX outbox_status_seq ON outbox (status, seq)
CREATE INDEX entity_history_entity ON entity_history (entity, entity_id)
